channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: Why Team USA Is My Pick For Gold Over Canada
item.description: Many people are picking Canada to win a gold medal in the 2026 Olympics men's hockey tournament. However, Team USA is clearly a co-favorite and could win to nobody's surprise.

item.title: What The 2026 NHL All-Star Rosters Would Have Looked Like
item.description: The NHL hasn't had an All-Star Game since 2024, and won't run the event until 2027, but today, we look at what the rosters could have looked like if the NHL did host an All-Star Game.

item.title: Olympics Men's Hockey Primer: Group Format, Rules, Odds And More
item.description: The 2026 Olympics are here. What is the format of the men's hockey tournament? What's the point system, overtime and shootout format? What are the gold medal odds? We answer those questions and more.

item.title: Can An NHL Defenseman Lead The Olympics In Scoring Or Win MVP Honors?
item.description: A defenseman led the NHL's 4 Nations Face-Off and the 2014 Olympics in scoring. Not only is there a decent chance of a blueliner doing so again at the 2026 Olympics, but they could contend for MVP honors as well.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Latest On Rangers' Trocheck, Canucks' Garland And Leafs' McMann
item.description: Rangers center Vincent Trocheck could draw lots of interest as the trade deadline approaches. Meanwhile, the Canucks must decide if they'll trade or retain Conor Garland, while Bobby McMann could be the Maple Leafs' best trade chip.

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show: Men's Olympic Preview, X-Factors And More
item.description: Ryan Kennedy, Michael Traikos and Andrew McInnis preview the men's hockey side of the 2026 Olympics, such as X-factors, goalies, lines and more.

item.title: Who's Hot And Cold In The NHL: Five Olympians Stood Out Before Heading To Milan
item.description: Four NHL players had particularly strong weeks before heading to the Olympics. One Team Canada center, however, will want results in Milan.

item.title: Matthew Tkachuk Appears To Carry The Battle Of Florida Over To The Olympics
item.description: Matthew Tkachuk called his Florida Panthers teammate, Sam Bennett, an upgrade for Team Canada over injured Tampa Bay Lightning center Anthony Cirelli.

item.title: Olympics: Team Canada Spreads Out The Snot In Practice Lines
item.description: Team Canada's initial practice forward lines balance elite skill with gritty "snot" on every forward line.

item.title: 'She's Irreplaceable': Canada Captain Poulin Suffers Injury Scare Ahead Of Huge Game
item.description: With Canada facing the United States on Tuesday, the biggest question will be about the status of their captain and top player, Marie-Philip Poulin.
